bugs.description: The `onRemove` callback is invoked without checking if it's defined, leading to a runtime error if `onRemove` is not provided.
The `title` attribute of the span now displays the derived `displayName` instead of the full `attendee.email`, which reduces the helpfulness of the tooltip for identification.

The logical OR operator (`||`) was incorrectly replaced with an AND operator (`&&`) when determining the `displayName`, causing the `firstName` to be ignored in favor of the email prefix or 'Unknown' even when `firstName` is provided.
